div.div: Each region is named by its role, with its Docker network name below. Only Caddy publishes public ingress ports; Dozzle binds the host loopback only. A name:port is the DNS name on that network and the port the target listens on.

div.div: Alloy also joins edge to scrape Caddy's metrics, and both app networks (compose.override.yaml written by the playbook) to probe AI and Bifrost and scrape AI's /metrics by container name.
